IIIII.    ADDITIONAL RULE – TEXAS AUTO BURGLARY AND THEFT PREVENTION FEE 
 
The Automobile Burglary and Theft Prevention Authority fee of $2.00 is payable in addition to the premium due under 
this policy.  This fee reimburses the insurer, as permitted by 28 TAC §5.205, for the $2.00 fee per motor vehicle year 
required to be paid to the Automobile Burglary and Theft Prevention Authority under Texas Civil Statutes, Article 
4413(37), §10, which was effective on June 6, 1991, and revised effective September 1, 2011. 
 
Texas Automobile Burglary and Theft Prevention Authority Notice, AE TST TX1502 is to be attached to all Texas Auto 
policies.
